critical_safety_warning: CRITICAL WARNING: High downstream classifier confidence does NOT validate localization accuracy. Downstream ViT-B/16 assigns high confidence (>90%) to both genuine inscriptions and non-inscribed rock textures / modern scratches. Spatial IoU and epigraphic stroke verification must be evaluated independently from classification probability.
